defold/extension-rive/rive.cmd

Command queue helpers for interacting with the Rive runtime

  • GitHub: defold/extension-rive — pinned to 13.1.0 (released while Defold 1.13.1 was current)
    1. Pick a release from defold/extension-rive releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

rive.cmd.instantiateArtboardNamed(file_handle: FileHandle, artboard_name: string): ArtboardHandle

Returns the artboard handle created for the named artboard.

Parameters

  • file_handle: FileHandle — Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.
  • artboard_name: string — Name of the artboard to instantiate.

Returns

  • artboard_handle: ArtboardHandle — Artboard handle created for the named artboard.

rive.cmd.instantiateDefaultArtboard(file_handle: FileHandle): ArtboardHandle

Returns the default artboard handle for the file.

Parameters

  • file_handle: FileHandle — Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.

Returns

  • artboard_handle: ArtboardHandle — Default artboard handle for the file.

rive.cmd.deleteArtboard(artboard_handle: ArtboardHandle)

Deletes an instantiated artboard.

Parameters

  • artboard_handle: ArtboardHandle — Handle to the artboard that should be removed.

rive.cmd.instantiateStateMachineNamed(artboard_handle: ArtboardHandle, name: string): StateMachineHandle

Creates a named state machine for the provided artboard.

Parameters

  • artboard_handle: ArtboardHandle — Artboard where the state machine resides.
  • name: string — Name to assign to the new state machine.

Returns

  • state_machine_handle: StateMachineHandle — Handle referencing the created state machine.

rive.cmd.instantiateDefaultStateMachine(artboard_handle: ArtboardHandle): StateMachineHandle

Creates the default state machine for an artboard.

Parameters

  • artboard_handle: ArtboardHandle — Artboard used as the source for the state machine.

Returns

  • state_machine_handle: StateMachineHandle — Handle referencing the created state machine.

rive.cmd.advanceStateMachine(state_machine_handle: StateMachineHandle, delta: number)

Advances the state machine by the requested delta time.

Parameters

  • state_machine_handle: StateMachineHandle — State machine to advance.
  • delta: number — Time in seconds to advance the state machine.

rive.cmd.bindViewModelInstance(state_machine_handle: StateMachineHandle, view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle)

Binds the state machine to the provided view model instance.

Parameters

  • state_machine_handle: StateMachineHandle — State machine handle.
  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — View model instance handle.

rive.cmd.deleteStateMachine(state_machine_handle: StateMachineHandle)

Deletes a created state machine.

Parameters

  • state_machine_handle: StateMachineHandle — Handle to the state machine to delete.

rive.cmd.instantiateBlankViewModelInstance(file_handle: FileHandle, artboard_or_viewmodel: ArtboardHandle | string): ViewModelInstanceHandle

Returns a blank view model instance handle for the given artboard or view model.

Parameters

  • file_handle: FileHandle — Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.
  • artboard_or_viewmodel: ArtboardHandle | string — Artboard handle or view model name that identifies where to instantiate.

Returns

  • view_model_instance_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Blank view model instance handle.

rive.cmd.instantiateDefaultViewModelInstance(file_handle: FileHandle, artboard_or_viewmodel: ArtboardHandle | string): ViewModelInstanceHandle

Returns a default-populated view model instance handle for the given artboard or view model.

Parameters

  • file_handle: FileHandle — Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.
  • artboard_or_viewmodel: ArtboardHandle | string — Artboard handle or view model name the instance should derive from.

Returns

  • view_model_instance_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Default view model instance handle.

rive.cmd.instantiateViewModelInstanceNamed(file_handle: FileHandle, artboard_or_viewmodel: ArtboardHandle | string, instance_name: string): ViewModelInstanceHandle

Creates a named view model instance and returns its handle.

Parameters

  • file_handle: FileHandle — Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.
  • artboard_or_viewmodel: ArtboardHandle | string — Artboard handle or view model name that will host the instance.
  • instance_name: string — Name to assign to the new view model instance.

Returns

  • view_model_instance_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Named view model instance handle.

rive.cmd.referenceNestedViewModelInstance(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, path: string): ViewModelInstanceHandle

Returns a handle to the nested view model at the given path.

Parameters

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Parent view model instance handle.
  • path: string — Dot-delimited path to the nested view model.

Returns

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Handle to the nested view model.

rive.cmd.referenceListViewModelInstance(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, path: string, index: number): ViewModelInstanceHandle

Returns the handle for the list entry at the specified path and index.

Parameters

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Parent view model instance handle.
  • path: string — Dot-delimited path to the list view model.
  • index: number — Index within the list entry to reference. 0️⃣ 0-based; passed to rive.cmd unchanged.

Returns

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Handle to the referenced list entry.

rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceNestedViewModel(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, path: string, nested_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle)

Replaces the nested view model at the given path with the supplied handle.

Parameters

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — View model instance whose nested child is updated.
  • path: string — Path to the nested view model.
  • nested_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Handle of the nested view model to attach.

rive.cmd.insertViewModelInstanceListViewModel(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, path: string, nested_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, index: number)

Inserts a nested view model into the list at the given index.

Parameters

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — View model instance owning the list.
  • path: string — Path to the target list.
  • nested_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Handle of the view model to insert.
  • index: number — Destination index for the insertion. 0️⃣ 0-based; passed to rive.cmd unchanged.

rive.cmd.appendViewModelInstanceListViewModel(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, path: string, nested_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle)

Appends a nested view model to the list at the specified path.

Parameters

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — View model instance owning the list.
  • path: string — Path to the target list.
  • nested_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Handle of the view model to append.

rive.cmd.swapViewModelInstanceListValues(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, path: string, indexa: number, indexb: number)

Swaps two entries in the nested list.

Parameters

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — View model instance that owns the list.
  • path: string — Path to the nested list.
  • indexa: number — First index to swap. 0️⃣ 0-based; passed to rive.cmd unchanged.
  • indexb: number — Second index to swap. 0️⃣ 0-based; passed to rive.cmd unchanged.

rive.cmd.removeViewModelInstanceListViewModelIndex(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, path: string, index: number)

Removes the entry at the supplied index from the nested list.

Parameters

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — View model instance owning the list.
  • path: string — Path to the target list.
  • index: number — Index of the entry to remove. 0️⃣ 0-based; passed to rive.cmd unchanged.

rive.cmd.removeViewModelInstanceListViewModel(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle, path: string, nested_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle)

Removes the specified nested view model from the list at the path.

Parameters

  • view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — View model instance owning the list.
  • path: string — Path to the target list.
  • nested_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle — Handle of the view model to remove.

rive.cmd.deleteViewModelInstance(view_model_handle: ViewModelInstanceHandle)

Deletes the view model instance handle.

Parameters
